faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about BridoConnect.
faq.q1.question: How does BridoConnect protect my money?
faq.q1.answer: Funds are reserved in the system until both sides confirm the deal. If a deal is not fulfilled, the money goes back to the donor within 3–5 business days. All transactions are secured by Stripe.
faq.q2.question: What is the platform fee?
faq.q2.answer: The standard fee is 5%. For Premium users it is 0%. The fee covers verification, support and platform security.
faq.q3.question: How do I verify my account?
faq.q3.answer: Go to the Verification section and upload an identity document together with a selfie holding it. Our team reviews the documents within 24 hours.
faq.q4.question: Who can request help?
faq.q4.answer: Anyone who has found themselves in a difficult situation — because of war, a natural disaster, illness or other circumstances. Account verification is required in order to receive help.
faq.q5.question: How are requests reviewed?
faq.q5.answer: Every request goes through both an automated and a manual review by our Trust & Safety team. Verified accounts carry a badge and get priority in the feed.
faq.q6.question: Can I help with goods instead of money?
faq.q6.answer: Yes. In the Shop section, verified organisations and volunteers list goods — clothing, food, medicine. You can order delivery straight to the recipient.
faq.q7.question: How does live streaming work?
faq.q7.answer: Recipients can start a live stream to show their situation. Viewers send donations right during the broadcast. The money is credited instantly.
faq.q8.question: What is BridoConnect Premium?
faq.q8.answer: The Premium subscription removes the platform fee (0% instead of 5%) and gives you priority in the feed, a gold verification badge and access to extended analytics.
faq.q9.question: How do I withdraw funds?
faq.q9.answer: Funds can be withdrawn to a bank account or a card. The minimum withdrawal is €10. The money arrives within 1–3 business days.
faq.q10.question: Is BridoConnect an official organisation?
faq.q10.answer: Yes. BridoConnect GmbH is registered in Germany (Frankfurt am Main). We operate in accordance with EU law and the GDPR.
about.title: About us
about.intro: BridoConnect was founded in 2024 by a team of people whose own lives were touched by the humanitarian crisis. We removed the middlemen between those who want to help and those who need that help.
about.value.humanity.title: Humanity
about.value.humanity.desc: Every person deserves dignified help without bureaucracy.
about.value.trust.title: Trust
about.value.trust.desc: Verification, protected deals and transparency are the foundation of the platform.
about.value.global.title: Global reach
about.value.global.desc: Help without borders: from Kharkiv to Damascus.
about.value.community.title: Community
about.value.community.desc: We are building a network of people who care, all over the world.
howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: BridoConnect is a transparent P2P platform for humanitarian aid without middlemen.
howItWorks.step1.title: Find someone who needs help
howItWorks.step1.desc: Browse verified requests in the feed. Filter by category, country or amount.
howItWorks.step2.title: Get in touch and agree
howItWorks.step2.desc: Contact the person directly through the secure chat. Clarify the details before you send any money.
howItWorks.step3.title: A protected deal
howItWorks.step3.desc: The money is reserved in the system. The recipient receives it only after fulfilment has been confirmed.
howItWorks.step4.title: Confirmation and review
howItWorks.step4.desc: Both sides confirm the deal. Leave a review and keep on helping.

verification.title: Account verification
verification.intro: Verified accounts receive a trust badge and get priority in the feed. The check takes 2–5 minutes.
verification.step1.title: Identity document
verification.step1.desc: Passport, ID card or residence permit — photographed straight into the camera
verification.step2.title: Selfie check
verification.step2.desc: A short capture of your face, matched against the document automatically
verification.step3.title: The data stays with Stripe
verification.step3.desc: The documents are processed by the certified provider Stripe Identity. BridoConnect never sees or stores the scans
verification.secure.title: Your data is protected
verification.secure.body: The check is carried out by Stripe Identity (GDPR, PCI DSS). BridoConnect only receives the result “confirmed / not confirmed” — no copies of any documents.
verification.pending.title: Check in progress
verification.pending.body: Complete the steps on the Stripe page that has opened.
verification.pending.polling: The status will update here automatically.
verification.consent: By clicking, you agree that Stripe Identity may process your data to confirm your identity.
verification.verified.title: You are verified
verification.verified.desc: The trust badge is already on your profile. Thank you!
